headline: Fruit vendor killed in Chuadanga over trivial dispute
summary: A 60-year-old fruit vendor named Madhu was killed in Damurhuda, Chuadanga, following an argument over outstanding money with a vegetable seller. The incident occurred on Friday evening in Karpasdanga.
details: Madhu, a 60-year-old fruit vendor, was killed in Karpasdanga, Damurhuda, Chuadanga, on Friday evening. The incident stemmed from a minor dispute over outstanding money.
Madhu, son of late Siraj Ali, was a resident of Aramdanga village and sold fruit from a mobile stall at Muchir Bottola in Karpasdanga.

According to eyewitnesses, an argument escalated into a physical altercation between Madhu and a vegetable seller. During the fight, a metal object, similar to a tool used for piercing wood apples, was reportedly stabbed into Madhu's chest.

Sheikh Mesbah Uddin, Officer-in-Charge of Damurhuda Model Police Station, confirmed the incident. He stated that initial reports indicate a stabbing occurred due to a dispute between a vegetable and a fruit vendor on the footpath. Further details will emerge after the investigation.
